evidence: Fresh installed Python calls; reused frozen official R outputs after input hash verification. No new runtime or memory measurements.
distribution_definition: For each case and field, take the largest absolute difference over its available component pairs and SNPs; summarize those case maxima. Empty/no-CS results do not supply numeric posterior rows.

interpretation: Same-input comparisons isolate colocalisation arithmetic from fine-mapping differences.
The native end-to-end distributions include only cases where both fits converged; CS order is ignored and pairs use original component IDs.
region25/gwas reached 100 iterations without convergence in both implementations; its region is recorded separately.
D3_one_iteration intentionally stops after one iteration; D3_strict_purity intentionally has no credible set.
The numerical scales describe reproducibility of these computations, not statistical evidence for colocalisation.
